subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin correctly identified the psychic center of the Hall of Melting Mirrors using a lucky roll and dwarvish intuition, succeeding where all spellcasters failed.
source_quote: Thorin paused, looked around, and simply pointed.

subject: Chipgrin
fact: Chipgrin remarked he should have asked the dwarf first, then hastily clarified to Zalthir that he meant no offense by calling them a 'surface dweller'.
source_quote: Chipgrin stared at him for a long moment before muttering that he probably should have asked the dwarf first, then caught Zalthir's eye and hastily clarified that he meant no offense by that.

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar claimed the bone die was won off a blind Duergar in Gracklstugh, who said it was carved from the knucklebone of a saint who never told a lie, with a memory for the truth.
source_quote: The old mule swore it was carved from the knucklebone of a saint who never told a lie, said it had a memory for the truth. I thought he was just trying to cover his losses.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir used a special ability to inspect Jimjar and discovered he was immune to poison and psychic damage, could not be charmed or frightened, and shrugged off radiant energy and mundane weapons alike.
source_quote: Zalthir, long suspicious of the little gambler, reached out with a focused awareness and discovered that Jimjar was immune to poison and psychic damage, could not be charmed or frightened, and shrugged off radiant energy and mundane weapons alike.

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar noticed Zalthir’s scrutiny, offered a knowing wink, and vanished entirely from existence, leaving only the faint metallic clink of platinum coins echoing in the tunnel.
source_quote: Jimjar noticed the scrutiny, offered a knowing wink, and vanished entirely from existence, leaving only the faint metallic clink of platinum coins echoing in the tunnel behind him.

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar remarked that Juiblex was a loud, messy neighbor, but Zuggtmoy preferred to move in while you're sleeping.
source_quote: Juiblex was a loud, messy neighbor, but this sister, she prefers to move in while you're sleeping.

subject: Jimjar's true nature
fact: Jimjar's stat block resembled that of an angel or deity, but his origin and purpose remain unexplained and unresolved by the party.
source_quote: Zalthir, long suspicious of the little gambler, reached out with a focused awareness and discovered that Jimjar was immune to poison and psychic damage, could not be charmed or frightened, and shrugged off radiant energy and mundane weapons alike — a profile that matched no ordinary gnome, and bore a striking resemblance to something far more divine.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz received the Voucher of the Varmint — a braided rat's foot — from Chief Chipgrin, a token recognized by wererats and outcasts from Blingdenstone to Menzoberranzan.
source_quote: Chief Chipgrin pressed a braided rat's foot into Daz's hand — the Voucher of the Varmint, he called it, a token recognized by wererats and outcasts from Blingdenstone all the way to Menzoberranzan.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum used a cantrip to attach the Diggermattock Miners patch onto Thorin's gear with such precision that everyone was more impressed by the needlework than the engineering feat.
source_quote: Grygum, not to be outdone, used a cantrip to attach the patch with such precision that everyone present was briefly more impressed by the needlework than by the feat of engineering.

subject: Diggermattock
fact: Diggermattock personally threaded a needle and sewed a Diggermattock Miners patch onto Thorin's gear, declaring him an honorary member of the crew.
source_quote: Diggermattock was so moved that he personally threaded a needle and sewed a Diggermattock Miners patch onto Thorin's gear, declaring him an honorary member of the crew.

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar tossed a small bone die onto Glabbagool, causing it to briefly become a bridge between every ooze in the cavern, connecting jellies, puddings, and cubes alike.
source_quote: Jimjar tossed a small bone die onto Glabbagool. A strange blink rippled through the air, and then something extraordinary happened: Glabbagool briefly became a bridge between every ooze in the cavern, a single vast mind connecting jellies, puddings, and cubes alike.

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool spoke in a gentle and earnest way, telling the oozes that the world was fine, that everyone could get along, and that there was really no need to kill anyone.
source_quote: He told them, in his gentle and earnest way, that the world was fine, that everyone could get along, and that there was really no need to kill anyone.

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar explained that in a place where the blink had turned the world's math into a bad joke, a little uncertainty could go a long way.
source_quote: Jimjar shrugged and said he had figured that in a place where the blink had turned the world's math into a bad joke, a little uncertainty could go a long way.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz delivered a passionate appeal for unity, urging the assembled leaders of Blingdenstone to set aside their egos and build an alliance strong enough to outlast the demons.
source_quote: Daz stepped forward and delivered a passionate appeal for unity, urging the assembled leaders to set aside their egos and build an alliance strong enough to outlast the demons.

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar pointed to a pale white puffball mushroom growing at impossible speed from a crack in the wall, its scent cloyingly sweet, like a feast left to rot in a hothouse.
source_quote: Jimjar pointed to a pale white puffball mushroom growing at impossible speed from a crack in the wall, its scent cloyingly sweet, like a feast left to rot in a hothouse.

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar vanished entirely from existence after winking at Zalthir, leaving only the faint metallic clink of platinum coins echoing in the tunnel.
source_quote: Jimjar noticed the scrutiny, offered a knowing wink, and vanished entirely from existence, leaving only the faint metallic clink of platinum coins echoing in the tunnel behind him.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum paid the ten platinum pieces without complaint after Jimjar's bet with Glabbagool succeeded.
source_quote: Grygum paid the ten platinum pieces without complaint.

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar had won the bone die off a blind Duergar in Gracklstugh, who claimed it was carved from the knucklebone of a saint who never told a lie.
source_quote: The old mule swore it was carved from the knucklebone of a saint who never told a lie, said it had a memory for the truth.

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar handed the spent bone die to the party as a keepsake after using it to pacify the oozes.
source_quote: The die rolled out of Glabbagool a moment later, spent and inert, and Jimjar handed it to the party as a keepsake.

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar tossed a bone die onto Glabbagool, triggering a mysterious 'blink' that caused the oozes to become mindless and peaceful.
source_quote: Jimjar tosses a bone die onto Glabbagool, triggering a mysterious 'blink' that causes the oozes to become mindless and peaceful.

subject: Glabbagool

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar winks at the party and vanishes into thin air, heading back toward Blingdenstone.
